cards.text: ELEANOR — EUROPEAN TRAVEL STORYBOARD

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Revised September 12: four DIFFERENT photographed women and four different Birkin-family bags in the opening grid; Eleanor appears at its spoken introduction. Paris, Milan, London and train payoff use four distinct GPT Image 2 women and casual phone-photo treatment. P01 remains the intentional continuous guide. Approved narration preserved. Actual selected replacement images attached; times provisional. Casting revision: Milan portrait and matching jewelry detail replaced to match the sophisticated white female brand avatar; distinct women retained across outfit examples.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: If you're going to Europe this fall, here's how I'd style one beautiful travel bag for Paris, Milan and London. Three different looks, without buying a whole new wardrobe for every stop.
Four distinct photographed women: tan, black, taupe and burgundy Birkin-family bags. 2×2 source-photo grid with persistent lower-left P01 guide.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Four distinct attractive looks immediately establish European travel aspiration and the range of bag styling. Simultaneous juxtaposition makes variety readable before the named Eleanor reveal. Hold the grid through the full hook; no spinning/panel transitions.

GPT Image 2 composed layout based on four actual sourced photographs; original photographs supplied separately. Their commercial reuse is unverified. Do not present them as Velantra endorsers. Hold photos; no generated action necessary. Hook caption at the seam protects bags; later captions lower center.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Starting with Paris, I'd keep everything relaxed. Straight-leg jeans, a cream knit, a trench and loafers. Then carry the Eleanor by the top handles. The bag gives those simple pieces a more finished look, even when you're just arriving at your hotel.
Different woman: short dark bob, cream knit, straight jeans, trench, loafers, carrying Eleanor at a modest Paris hotel entrance, friend-shot framing. Selected revised asset.

cards.title: EMOTION

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: And for London, I'd have a little more fun. A checked jacket, relaxed trousers, comfortable sneakers. Let the textures do the work. The canvas and leather sit so nicely alongside those autumn layers.
New copper-haired woman seated on a station-exterior bench, checked jacket, relaxed trousers and sneakers; hand grips Eleanor handles before pickup.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: That's what I like about building your travel wardrobe around a bag like this. You can change the whole mood with your clothes, and your weekender still feels like part of the outfit.
Fresh everyday wardrobe-rail still with Eleanor and three clothing groups; use natural window light, imperfect spacing. Selected revised asset.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Because the outfit you wear between cities deserves just as much thought as the one you wear when you get there.
New silver-haired woman at train doorway, navy coat and scarf, holding Eleanor while adjusting her scarf.

cards.title: EMOTION

NOTES

cards.title: CAST VARIETY
cards.text: Hook: four actual photographed women and four different bags. Body: short dark bob in Paris, white woman with chestnut waves in Milan, copper-haired seated woman in London, silver-haired woman at train. Keep P01 as the continuous adviser. Velantra casting direction: sophisticated white female models, with different identities across examples.

cards.title: SOURCE VS GENERATED
cards.text: Hook layout is GPT Image 2 compositing from actual source photographs; original sources are attached. Product scenes are synthetic GPT Image 2 style illustrations. Source photo commercial reuse remains unverified. No endorsement inferred.

cards.title: APPROVED WORDS
cards.text: Exact approved narration preserved. Provisional 84-second timing includes final two-second hold. No new voice or final word alignment in this revision.

cards.title: NUAMORE TREATMENT
cards.text: Ordinary light, casual poses, visible fabric and skin texture, imperfect phone framing; outfit-to-worn-detail sequence, persistent lower-left guide, direct cuts and restrained detail crop. Exact camera, font and audio settings are unverified.

cards.title: CAPTIONS + SOUND
cards.text: White sentence-case phrases with dark outline. Hook caption crosses grid seam; later phrases stay near lower center, clear of bag/hands/shoes. Continuous adviser speech; optional quiet music, no decorative whooshes, two-second close.
